introduction:
Introduction About REVOCON 25MG TABLET

REVOCON 25MG TABLET contains Tetrabenazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Vesicular monoamine transporter 2 inhibitors. REVOCON 25MG TABLET is used to manage diseases that cause hyperkinetic motor disorders (such as jerky, irregular, uncontrollable movements) associated with Huntington's chorea (an inherited neurodegenerative disease) in affected individuals.

REVOCON 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Tetrabenazine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from Parkinson-like symptoms, depression, active suicidal thoughts, pheochromocytoma (tumor of the adrenal gland), and/or kidney disorders.

Before taking REVOCON 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are intolerant to certain sugars (such as lactose), and/or have heart problems (such as long QT syndrome, heart rhythm disorders), liver problems (such as mild, moderate/severe hepatic disorders).

REVOCON 25MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking REVOCON 25MG TABLET are confusion, anxiety, sleeplessness, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any these symptoms worsen.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking REVOCON 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Reserpine (used to control high blood pressure and manage psychosis)
Antidepressants (used to manage depression) such as MAO inhibitors (Ex. phenelzine, selegiline)
Levodopa (used to manage Parkinson’s disease)
Opioids (used to control pain) Ex. oxycodone, hydrocodone
Antihypertensive drugs (used to manage high blood pressure) Ex. telmisartan, chlorthalidone
Beta blockers (used to manage heart problems) Ex. acebutolol, atenolol
Medicines used to manage psychotic disorders such as hypnotics (Ex. ambien, belsomra), neuroleptics (Ex. butaperazine)
CYP2D6 inhibitors (medicines used to reduce the metabolism of certain medicines) Ex. fluoxetine, paroxetine, terbinafine, moclobemide, quinidine
Medicines that prolong the QTc interval in the ECG (Ex. haloperidol, droperidol)
Certain antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. gatifloxacin, moxifloxacin
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm conditions (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, amiodarone, sotalol)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of REVOCON 25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are uncontrollable muscle spasms (affecting eyes, head, neck and body), uncontrolled rolling of eyes, excessive blinking of eye, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, sweating, dizziness, feeling cold, confusion, hallucinations, drowsiness, redness/inflammation, and/or tremor.

introduction:
Introduction About TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET

TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET contain Neostigmine which belongs to a group of medicine called Cholinergic drugs. It is mainly used for the management of myasthenia gravis (a chronic autoimmune disorder in which antibodies destroy the communication between nerves and muscle, characterised by weakness in the arm and leg muscles, double vision, trouble speaking and chewing).

TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET is also used to normalise intestinal movements and for the management of urinary retention after surgery. TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have blockage in your intestine or face difficulty urinating.

Before taking TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET tell your doctor if you have asthma, fits, stomach ulcer or Parkinson’s disease. TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and breast-feeding women.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET for your child depending on their age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms worsen or persist.

Normalises intestinal movements
Manage urinary retention after surgery
mechanismOfAction:
How TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET Works

TILSTIGMIN 15MG TABLET increases muscle strength by blocking the action of an enzyme in the body which blocks nerve impulses to muscles. By stopping this enzyme from working, it strengthens muscles and thus helps in easing of intestinal movements and urinary retention.

introduction:
Introduction About DISTINON 60MG TABLET

Distinon 60mg Tablet contains Pyridostigmine Bromide, often included in care routines that support neuromuscular function. It may be advised by healthcare experts for individuals managing certain muscle-related conditions like myasthenia gravis, paralytic ileus (paralysis of digestive tract muscles) and urinary retention after surgery. It is commonly used as part of a broader care approach under medical supervision.

Pyridostigmine works by stopping the breakdown of a chemical called acetylcholine, which is required to stimulate muscle movement by improving the communication between nerves and muscles.

Do not take DISTINON 60MG if your digestive or urinary tract is obstructed. Inform your doctor if you have kidney, heart, or thyroid problems, stomach ulcer, fits, or parkinson’s disease. DISTINON 60MG should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by your doctor. It should be used with caution among breastfeeding women.

Common side effects of taking DISTINON 60MG are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach cramps or pains, low blood pressure, muscle cramps and twitching. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DISTINON 60MG TABLET Works
Blocks Acetylcholinesterase Activity
Pyridostigmine temporarily blocks the enzyme called acetylcholinesterase, which normally breaks down acetylcholine (a neurotransmitter).
Increases Acetylcholine Levels at Neuromuscular Junctions
By preventing this breakdown, the amount of acetylcholine in the neuromuscular junction increases. This leads to improved signaling between nerves and muscles.
Enhances Muscle Contraction
The boost in acetylcholine helps the muscles receive stronger signals, improving muscle contraction and strength, especially useful in conditions where this communication is weak.

How Should You Take Distinon 60mg Tablet?

Distinon 60mg is typically taken orally with a glass of water. It is important to follow the dosage schedule recommended by your healthcare provider. The dosage may vary depending on your age, muscle strength, and how your body responds to the medicine.

Can Distinon Be Taken With or Without Food?

Distinon can be taken with or without food, although some individuals may find it easier on the stomach when taken after a light meal or snack. If it causes stomach discomfort or nausea, taking it with food may help minimize these effects.

When Is the Best Time to Take Distinon 60mg?

The ideal time to take Distinon depends on your daily routine and symptom pattern.

Many individuals take their first dose in the morning, especially if symptoms like muscle weakness appear early in the day.
Spacing doses evenly through the day helps maintain steady levels in the body.

Always follow the interval and frequency recommended by your doctor.

Dosage Frequency and Duration: What to Know
The usual frequency ranges from 2 to 5 times daily, depending on individual needs.
Dosage intervals may be customized (e.g., every 4 to 6 hours) to match symptom timing.
Avoid sudden stopping; always consult your doctor before making any changes.

The total duration of use is based on clinical evaluation and progress tracking.

How to Take Distinon 60mg Safely at Home

Here are a few tips for safe use at home:

Store at room temperature, away from heat or moisture.
Keep track of your muscle strength or energy levels to discuss at your next follow-up.
Maintain a medicine log or diary if taking multiple medications.
Keep the tablet in its original packaging to avoid confusion.

warnings.details: Pyridostigmine has been classified by the U.S. FDA as Pregnancy Category C, meaning animal studies have shown adverse effects, and there are no well-controlled studies in humans but potential benefits may outweigh risks in certain cases. Animal reproduction studies report mild to moderate effects on fetal weight or development, but typically only at very high doses.

DISTINON 60MG should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as a small amount is passed in the breast milk. Lactating individuals may be able to use pyridostigmine under medical supervision, monitoring the infant for signs of increased secretions, restlessness, or feeding difficulties is advisable.
Consult your doctor if you have any side effect that may stop you from driving or using machines.

DISTINON 60MG is not considered for use in patients who cannot pass urine because of an obstruction. DISTINON 60MG should be taken cautiously in patients with kidney disease or impairment. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DISTINON 60MG if you are allergic to Pyridostigmine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DISTINON 60MG should be used cautiously in patients with obstructive respiratory diseases like bronchial asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
DISTINON 60MG should be taken cautiously in patients with slow heart rate, a recent blockage in a blood vessel to the heart, low blood pressure, or irregular heartbeat.
Your doctor will prescribe the correct dose of DISTINON 60MG for your child, depending on age, body weight and health condition.
DISTINON 60MG should be used cautiously in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) with irregular heartbeat or other heart condition.

Did you know

Pyridostigmine bromide was first introduced in the 1950s as a derivative of neostigmine, designed to have fewer gastrointestinal side effects and a longer duration of action. It is now used globally in supporting conditions involving nerve-to-muscle transmission.
Pyridostigmine was issued as a nerve agent pretreatment in military settings (e.g., during the Gulf War) to help preserve enzyme function in case of exposure to certain chemical agents. This highlights its unique pharmacological properties and global significance.
Distinon does not act on muscles directly. Instead, it enhances the communication between nerves and muscles, helping improve voluntary movement in conditions where this transmission is disrupted.
Taking Distinon with food may delay how quickly it starts working, but it may reduce stomach-related side effects like cramping or nausea. That is why dosing schedules are often customized.
Distinon is frequently included in international clinical guidelines for supporting individuals with autoimmune or genetic neuromuscular transmission disorders—conditions that often require lifelong management and support.

Introduction About GRAVITOR 60MG TABLET

GRAVITOR TABLET contains Pyridostigmine which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinesterase Inhibitors. It is widely used in india to manage conditions such as myasthenia gravis (a disease-causing muscle weakness and tiredness), paralytic ileus (paralysis of intestinal muscles), and postoperative urinary retention. This medicine helps in strengthening muscles, supporting bowel function, and stimulating bladder muscles. Pyridostigmine works by blocking the enzyme acetylcholinesterase, which breaks down acetylcholine, thereby increasing acetylcholine levels at nerve endings to enhance muscle contraction and improve muscle strength.

Take Gravitor Tablet on an empty stomach, preferably at the same time each day. Use the medicine exactly as directed by your doctor regarding the dose and duration. If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you recall. Do not skip any doses and ensure you complete the full course of management. Never discontinue this medication suddenly without medical advice.

Common side effects of Gravitor Tablet include nausea, vomiting, excessive salivation, diarrhea, blurred vision, shortness of breath, watery eyes, abdominal pain, and changes in urination frequency. Other possible side effects are muscle cramps and twitching, sweating, headache, dizziness, runny nose, and heartburn. It may also cause dizziness and drowsiness, so avoid activities requiring focus and attention, such as driving or operating machinery.

Before taking Gravitor Tablet, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems, Parkinson’s disease, asthma, or stomach disorders. This medicine may cause a drop in blood pressure, so it is important to monitor it and consult your doctor if you experience any discomfort. As Gravitor Tablet can cause diarrhea, make sure to drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated. Also, notify your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to conceive, or breastfeeding before taking this medication.

How GRAVITOR 60MG TABLET Works

Gravitor Tablet contains Pyridostigmine, which helps improve muscle strength by enhancing communication between nerves and muscles. It is used to manage conditions where muscle weakness occurs due to impaired nerve signals.

Mechanism of Action: Gravitor Tablet

Pyridostigmine works by inhibiting the enzyme acetylcholinesterase, which breaks down acetylcholine, a chemical messenger essential for muscle activation. By reducing acetylcholine breakdown, the medicine increases its availability at nerve endings to stimulate muscle contraction.

Science Behind Nerve-Muscle Communication

Muscle movement is controlled by signals transmitted from nerves to muscle fibers through neurotransmitters like acetylcholine. When a nerve impulse arrives, acetylcholine is released to activate muscle contraction. Proper levels of acetylcholine are critical for normal muscle function.

Gravitor Tablet and Acetylcholine

Gravitor Tablet increases acetylcholine levels at neuromuscular junctions by blocking acetylcholinesterase, the enzyme that degrades acetylcholine. This prolongs the action of acetylcholine, ensuring muscles receive stronger and more sustained stimulation.

Understanding Cholinesterase Inhibitors

Pyridostigmine, the active ingredient in Gravitor, belongs to a class of drugs called cholinesterase inhibitors. These drugs reduce the breakdown of acetylcholine, boosting nerve-muscle communication and improving muscle strength in diseases like myasthenia gravis.

Role of Pyridostigmine in Muscle Strength

By increasing acetylcholine availability, Pyridostigmine enhances the ability of muscles to contract and sustain force. This helps reduce symptoms of muscle weakness and fatigue, enabling better control over voluntary movements.

Enhanced Neurotransmission: What It Means

Enhanced neurotransmission refers to improved signal transmission from nerves to muscles. Gravitor Tablet supports this process by lowering acetylcholine degradation, which leads to improved muscle activation and alleviates weakness.

Supporting Healthy Muscle Function

Regular use of Gravitor Tablet helps maintain sufficient acetylcholine levels, supporting healthy muscle function and coordination. This is particularly important for patients suffering from neuromuscular conditions that cause muscle fatigue and weakness.

TICSTOP 25MG TABLET is used to manage diseases that cause hyperkinetic motor disorders (such as jerky, irregular, uncontrollable movements) associated with Huntington's chorea (an inherited neurodegenerative disease) in affected individuals.

TICSTOP 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Tetrabenazine. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from Parkinson-like symptoms, depression, active suicidal thoughts, pheochromocytoma (tumor of the adrenal gland), and/or kidney disorders.

Before taking TICSTOP 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are intolerant to certain sugars (such as lactose), and/or have heart problems (such as long QT syndrome, heart rhythm disorders), liver problems (such as mild, moderate/severe hepatic disorders).

TICSTOP 25MG TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TICSTOP 25MG TABLET are confusion, anxiety, sleeplessness, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and/or constipation. Consult your doctor if any these symptoms worsen.

Introduction About MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION

MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION contain Neostigmine which belongs to a group of medicine called Cholinergic drugs. It is mainly used for the management of myasthenia gravis (a chronic autoimmune disorder in which antibodies destruct the communication between nerves and muscle, characterised by weakness in the arm and leg muscles, double vision, trouble speaking and chewing).

MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION is also used to reverse the effects of muscle relaxants, normalise intestinal movements and manage urinary retention after surgery. MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have blockage in your intestine or face difficulty urinating, have peritonitis or any condition where your intestines may no longer be functioning.

Before receiving MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION tell your doctor if you have asthma, fits, stomach ulcer, Parkinson’s disease or any heart problem. MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

Your doctor will prescribe the right dose of MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION for your child depending on their age, body weight and disease condition.The most common side effects of receiving MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION are slow heartbeat, nausea and vomiting. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse over time.

How MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION Works

MYOSTIGMIN 2.5MG INJECTION increases muscle strength by blocking the action of an enzyme in the body which blocks nerve impulses to muscles. By stopping this enzyme from working, it strengthens muscles and thus helps in easing of intestinal movements and urinary retention.
